moments.title: Scottish Bank Holiday Today
moments.blurb: Scotland enjoys its Summer Bank Holiday today, offering a long weekend for many across the nation.

angles.name: Chill out
angles.copy: Monday mood: if you're in Scotland, it's a bank holiday! What are your plans for this bonus day off? Make the most of it!

angles.name: Sunny vibes
angles.copy: Long weekend in Scotland! Hope you're enjoying the Summer Bank Holiday. Perfect day for some tunes and sunshine (fingers crossed!).

angles.name: Scottish pride
